title: Reading Drill — Monitoring visitors in a quiet reading room — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Monitoring visitors in a quiet reading room — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The reference librarian in Foxhaven received an old report about people opening and closing heavy reference books abruptly. The report compared brief peaks in background noise, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the desk recordings rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered six weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include meetings in the next room. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed padded book supports as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
